{{Quote|Admiral, the commander lost control of the situation.|ES-02 to Vice Admiral Edmon Rampart regarding Crosshair's failure|<ref name="Return to Kamino">{{TBB|Return to Kamino}}</ref>}}
'''ES-02''' was the designation of a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Elite Squad Trooper]] who was recruited into the [[Imperial Military|military]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] in its early foundation by [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]]. She, along with her squadmates, was described by Rampart as one of the best [[soldier]]s in [[the galaxy]], and was brought into the [[Elite Squad]] under the leadership of [[Clone Commander]] [[Crosshair|CT-9904]] "Crosshair." During the Empire's [[Attack on Kamino|operation]] on [[Kamino]], ES-02 began to doubt her [[commander]]'s loyalty regarding his former unit, [[Clone Force 99]], who he intended to lure into a [[Rescue of Hunter|trap]] in [[Tipoca City]], and reported her concerns to Rampart. When she later discovered that Crosshair had lost control of the situation he had planned and the rest of the Elite Squad was [[Death|dead]], ES-02 departed Tipoca City as ordered before Rampart began bombarding the [[city]], leaving Crosshair to [[Death|die]].

==Biography==
===Mission on Onderon===
The [[human]] designated "ES-02"<ref name="Elite Squad">{{Databank|elite-squad|Elite Squad}}</ref> was a [[Gender|female]] [[soldier]]. After the [[Mission to Mustafar|end]] of the [[Clone Wars]], the new [[Galactic Empire]] sought to replace its [[clone trooper]]s with a wholly recruited military. As part of [[Project War-Mantle]], [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]] recruited four soldiers to be the first [[Elite Squad Trooper]]s. Besides ES-02, the [[Elite Squad|unit]] included [[ES-01]], [[ES-03]], and [[ES-04]]. The [[squad]] was placed under the command of [[Crosshair|CT-9904]], a modified [[Cloning|clone]] formerly known as "Crosshair," after being shown to [[Admiral]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] for inspection on [[Kamino]].<ref name="Replacements" />

They were subsequently sent on their [[Mission to Onderon (Elite Squad)|first mission]], ordered to find and kill the rebel leader [[Saw Gerrera]] and his [[Partisans|fighters]] On the [[shuttle]] journey to [[Onderon]], ES-02 silently listened as ES-01 challenged Crosshair's authority, claiming that he would soon become the [[commander]] of the unit as clones were inferior. ES-02 and the rest of the squad attacked several of Gerrera's fighters as they were attempting to evacuate civilian [[refugee]]s, although Gerrera was absent, [[Death|killing]] all of the fighters. After receiving no intel on Gerrera's whereabouts, Crosshair ordered the Elite Squad to execute the civilians. They were initially hesitant, but after he executed ES-01 for protesting the order, ES-02 and the rest of the squad complied.<ref name="Replacements" />

===Missions around the galaxy===
ES-02 later participated in a [[Mission on Bracca|mission]] to [[Bracca]], attempting to eliminate [[Clone Force 99]], Crosshair's former squad.<ref name="Reunion" /> The Elite Squad was later sent to [[Ryloth]],<ref name="Devil's Deal">{{TBB|Devil's Deal}}</ref> before participating in an Imperial [[Attack on Kamino|operation]] on Kamino, arresting [[Chief Medical Scientist]] [[Nala Se]] after she was discovered attempting to gather medical personnel to depart the [[planet]].<ref name="War Mantle">{{TBB|War-Mantle}}</ref>

===The end of Kamino===
[[File:ES02DoesntTrustCrosshair-RtK.png|thumb|right|250px|ES-02 expresses her distrust of Crosshair to Vice Admiral Rampart.]]
After [[Hunter]], the leader of Clone Force 99, was captured by Imperial forces on [[Daro]], ES-02 remained with her squad and Crosshair as they awaited the Bad Batch's arrival on [[Kamino]]. Wary of Crosshair's loyalty, she informed Rampart of her suspicions and was ordered to keep an eye on her commander. When her squad apprehended the remaining members of the Bad Batch, ES-02 was tasked with tracking down [[Omega]]. Upon locating the girl, she was then ordered to send her on a shuttle off-world, but was incapacitated by [[AZI-345211896246498721347|AZI-3]]. When she regained consciousness, ES-02 attempted to regroup with her squad, only to find them dead and Crosshair and the Bad Batch engaged in a firefight with the facility's [[DT-series sentry droid|training droids]]. One of the droids attempted to attack ES-02 but she promptly eliminated it and escaped from the training room. Retreating from the area, she informed Rampart of Crosshair's failure before evacuating [[Tipoca City]] prior to its destruction.<ref name="Return to Kamino" />

==Personality and traits==
ES-02 was a human female with pale skin and black [[hair]], which she wore in a bun. Loyal to the [[Galactic Empire]], ES-02 was initially apprehensive about killing civilians on Onderon, but complied after the execution of ES-01.<ref name="Replacements" /> When she began to suspect that Crosshair's loyalty to the Empire was wavering and that his plans for the Bad Batch were different than what Rampart wanted, she informed Rampart, and left her commander behind when she found he had lost control of the situation.<ref name="Return to Kamino" />

==Skills and abilities==
ES-02 was considered one of the best soldiers in the galaxy, enough so that she was selected to be one of the first Elite Squad Troopers.<ref name="Replacements" />

==Equipment==
Like other Elite Squad Troopers, ES-02 wore modified [[Phase II clone trooper armor]], which was fitted to match her body type.<ref name="Replacements Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=replacements-trivia-gallery|text=Tech's Notes: "Replacements" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 2}}</ref> In combat, she wielded a [[DC-15A blaster rifle]], which was modified to include a scope.<ref name="Replacements" />

==Behind the scenes==
ES-02 first appeared in the [[Replacements|third episode]] of the [[The Bad Batch Season 1|first season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', voiced by [[Tina Huang]].<ref name="Reunion" />
